Effective communication
Initiate the conversation
Maintain the conversation
Listen to and respond to the patient
Ask open questions
Respond to anything unexpected
Organise the consultation into stages

Ease of understanding
Accent : Easily understood by native speakers
Pronunciation : Say the words correctly
Word stress
 
Fluency
Speak smoothly
Speak in a moderate pace
Resist “Um” / “Argh”
Limit restarted sentences

Appropriate language
Use professional language
Avoid medical terms as much as possible
Adjust your language for the patient
Adjust your tone for the scenario
Address the patient’s concern

Grammar and Vocabulary
The importance of verb tenses
The importance of passive tense
The importance of articles
